WITH items AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.price, oi.shipping_limit_date
  FROM order_items oi
),
sales AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         COUNT(*) AS total_quantity_sold,
         SUM(price) AS total_sales,
         AVG(price) AS avg_item_price
  FROM items
  GROUP BY seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
packing AS (
  SELECT d.seller_id,
         AVG(julianday(d.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_packing_days
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id, shipping_limit_date FROM items) d
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = d.order_id
  GROUP BY d.seller_id
),
reviews AS (
  SELECT d.seller_id,
         AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id FROM items) d
  JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = d.order_id
  GROUP BY d.seller_id
),
cat AS (
  SELECT i.seller_id,
         COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_english,
         COUNT(*) AS category_qty,
         SUM(i.price) AS category_revenue
  FROM items i
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  GROUP BY i.seller_id, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
),
top_cat AS (
  SELECT seller_id, category_english
  FROM (
    SELECT c.seller_id,
           c.category_english,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.seller_id ORDER BY c.category_qty DESC, c.category_revenue DESC, c.category_english) AS rn
    FROM cat c
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT s.seller_id,
       s.total_quantity_sold,
       ROUND(s.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(s.avg_item_price, 2) AS avg_item_price,
       ROUND(rv.avg_review_score, 2) AS avg_review_score,
       ROUND(pk.avg_packing_days, 2) AS avg_packing_days,
       tc.category_english AS top_category_english
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN packing pk ON pk.seller_id = s.seller_id
LEFT JOIN reviews rv ON rv.seller_id = s.seller_id
LEFT JOIN top_cat tc ON tc.seller_id = s.seller_id
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         mth,
         qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS rn,
         (AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING)
          + AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING)) / 2.0 AS cma
  FROM monthly_sales
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         mth,
         CAST(qty AS REAL) / cma AS sales_to_cma
  FROM base
  WHERE rn BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    AND cma IS NOT NULL
    AND cma <> 0
)
SELECT product_id
FROM ratios
WHERE strftime('%Y', mth) = '2017'
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 12 AND MIN(sales_to_cma) > 2
ORDER BY product_id

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS customer_unique_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS number_of_orders,
         SUM(p.payment_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_payment_per_order,
         julianday(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS span_days
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT customer_unique_id,
       number_of_orders,
       avg_payment_per_order,
       CASE WHEN span_days < 7 THEN 1.0 ELSE span_days / 7.0 END AS customer_lifespan_weeks
FROM cust
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH career AS (
  SELECT b.player_id,
         SUM(b.g) AS g_total,
         SUM(b.r) AS r_total,
         SUM(b.h) AS h_total,
         SUM(b.hr) AS hr_total
  FROM batting AS b
  GROUP BY b.player_id
)
SELECT p.name_given, 'games played' AS stat, CAST(c.g_total AS INTEGER) AS score
FROM career AS c
INNER JOIN player AS p ON c.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE c.g_total = (SELECT MAX(g_total) FROM career)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.name_given, 'runs' AS stat, CAST(c.r_total AS INTEGER) AS score
FROM career AS c
INNER JOIN player AS p ON c.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE c.r_total = (SELECT MAX(r_total) FROM career)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.name_given, 'hits' AS stat, CAST(c.h_total AS INTEGER) AS score
FROM career AS c
INNER JOIN player AS p ON c.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE c.h_total = (SELECT MAX(h_total) FROM career)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.name_given, 'home runs' AS stat, CAST(c.hr_total AS INTEGER) AS score
FROM career AS c
INNER JOIN player AS p ON c.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE c.hr_total = (SELECT MAX(hr_total) FROM career)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%' THEN COALESCE(c.motorcyclist_killed_count, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%' THEN c.case_id END), 0), 2) AS helmet_used_fatality_pct, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN COALESCE(c.motorcyclist_killed_count, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN c.case_id END), 0), 2) AS helmet_not_used_fatality_pct FROM collisions AS c INNER JOIN parties AS p ON c.case_id = p.case_id WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1

SELECT w.name, l.name FROM Matches m JOIN Belts b ON b.id = m.title_id JOIN Wrestlers w ON w.id = m.winner_id JOIN Wrestlers l ON l.id = m.loser_id WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%' AND IFNULL(m.title_change, 0) <> 1 AND m.duration IS NOT NULL AND m.duration <> '' AND instr(m.duration, ':') > 0 ORDER BY (CAST(substr(m.duration, 1, instr(m.duration, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(m.duration, instr(m.duration, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) ASC LIMIT 1

WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT T1.seller_id, T1.order_id, T1.price, T1.freight_value, T3.customer_unique_id
  FROM olist_order_items T1
  INNER JOIN olist_orders T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id
  INNER JOIN olist_customers T3 ON T2.customer_id = T3.customer_id
  WHERE T2.order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Seller with the highest number of distinct customers' AS achievement, seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS value FROM delivered GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Seller with the highest profit (price minus freight value)', seller_id, SUM(price - freight_value) FROM delivered GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Seller with the highest number of distinct orders', seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM delivered GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Seller with the most 5-star ratings', T1.seller_id, COUNT(*) FROM olist_order_reviews T4 INNER JOIN olist_orders T2 ON T4.order_id = T2.order_id INNER JOIN olist_order_items T1 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE T2.order_status = 'delivered' AND T4.review_score = 5 GROUP BY T1.seller_id ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT c.name AS category,
       ROUND(SUM((julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) * 24), 2) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id
JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id
JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id
JOIN city ct ON ct.city_id = a.city_id
WHERE ct.city LIKE 'A%' OR ct.city LIKE '%-%'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH artist_sales AS (
  SELECT ar.ArtistId AS ArtistId, ar.Name AS Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_sales
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  JOIN albums a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN artists ar ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
  GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
top_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY total_sales DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 1
),
bottom_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY total_sales ASC, Name ASC LIMIT 1
),
spend AS (
  SELECT i.CustomerId AS CustomerId, a.ArtistId AS ArtistId, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS spent
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  JOIN albums a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN invoices i ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  WHERE a.ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)
     OR a.ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist)
  GROUP BY i.CustomerId, a.ArtistId
)
SELECT ABS(
  (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM spend WHERE ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist))
  -
  (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM spend WHERE ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist))
) AS difference_of_average_spending

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
),
mons AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS txn_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
),
grid AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.txn_month
  FROM cust c CROSS JOIN mons m
),
bal AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS txn_month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                  WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                  ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
    AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
  GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER)
),
full_bal AS (
  SELECT g.customer_id,
         g.txn_month,
         COALESCE(b.month_end_balance, 0) AS month_end_balance
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN bal b
    ON b.customer_id = g.customer_id
   AND b.txn_month = g.txn_month
),
month_stats AS (
  SELECT txn_month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_customers,
         AVG(CAST(month_end_balance AS REAL)) AS avg_month_end_balance
  FROM full_bal
  GROUP BY txn_month
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT txn_month,
         positive_customers,
         avg_month_end_balance,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customers DESC, txn_month ASC) AS rn_hi,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customers ASC, txn_month ASC) AS rn_lo
  FROM month_stats
)
SELECT h.txn_month AS month_most_positive_customers,
       h.positive_customers AS most_positive_customer_count,
       h.avg_month_end_balance AS avg_balance_most_positive_month,
       l.txn_month AS month_fewest_positive_customers,
       l.positive_customers AS fewest_positive_customer_count,
       l.avg_month_end_balance AS avg_balance_fewest_positive_month,
       h.avg_month_end_balance - l.avg_month_end_balance AS avg_balance_difference
FROM ranked h
JOIN ranked l ON h.rn_hi = 1 AND l.rn_lo = 1

WITH cust_spending AS (
  SELECT o.customerid AS customerid,
         SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) AS totalamount
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_details od ON od.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE strftime('%Y', o.orderdate) = '1998'
    AND o.customerid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.customerid
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS allcustomers FROM cust_spending
)
SELECT t.groupname AS groupname,
       COUNT(*) AS numberofcustomers,
       ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT allcustomers FROM totals), 2) AS percentage
FROM cust_spending cs
JOIN customergroupthreshold t
  ON cs.totalamount BETWEEN t.rangebottom AND t.rangetop
GROUP BY t.groupname, t.rangebottom
ORDER BY t.rangebottom

WITH rep_sales AS (
  SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, sr.name AS rep_name,
         COUNT(o.id) AS rep_orders, SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_amt
  FROM web_region r
  JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
  JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
  JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name, sr.name
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT region_id, SUM(rep_orders) AS num_orders, SUM(rep_amt) AS total_amt
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
)
SELECT rs.region_name, rt.num_orders, rt.total_amt, rs.rep_name, rs.rep_amt
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN rep_sales rs ON rs.region_id = rt.region_id
WHERE rs.rep_amt = (SELECT MAX(x.rep_amt) FROM rep_sales x WHERE x.region_id = rt.region_id)
ORDER BY rs.region_name, rs.rep_name

WITH sales AS (SELECT salespersonid AS id, CAST(strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS INTEGER) AS yr, SUM(totaldue) AS total_sales FROM salesorderheader WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY salespersonid, CAST(strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS INTEGER)), quotas AS (SELECT BusinessEntityID AS id, CAST(strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS INTEGER) AS yr, SUM(SalesQuota) AS total_quota FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, CAST(strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS INTEGER)), keys AS (SELECT id, yr FROM sales UNION SELECT id, yr FROM quotas) SELECT k.id AS SalesPersonID, k.yr AS Year, ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0), 2) AS TotalSales, ROUND(COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0), 2) AS TotalQuota, ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0), 2) AS SalesMinusQuota FROM keys k LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.id = k.id AND s.yr = k.yr LEFT JOIN quotas q ON q.id = k.id AND q.yr = k.yr ORDER BY k.id, k.yr

WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.name_id AS director_id,
         n.name AS director_name,
         m.date_published AS dp,
         m.duration AS duration,
         r.avg_rating AS avg_rating,
         r.total_votes AS total_votes
  FROM director_mapping d
  JOIN names n ON n.id = d.name_id
  JOIN movies m ON m.id = d.movie_id
  JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = d.movie_id
),
seq AS (
  SELECT director_id,
         dp,
         LAG(dp) OVER (PARTITION BY director_id ORDER BY dp) AS prev_dp
  FROM base
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT director_id,
         AVG(julianday(dp) - julianday(prev_dp)) AS avg_gap
  FROM seq
  WHERE prev_dp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY director_id
),
agg AS (
  SELECT director_id,
         director_name,
         COUNT(*) AS num_movies,
         ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
         SUM(total_votes) AS total_votes,
         MIN(avg_rating) AS min_rating,
         MAX(avg_rating) AS max_rating,
         SUM(duration) AS total_duration
  FROM base
  GROUP BY director_id, director_name
)
SELECT a.director_id,
       a.director_name,
       a.num_movies,
       ROUND(COALESCE(g.avg_gap, 0)) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
       a.avg_rating,
       a.total_votes,
       a.min_rating,
       a.max_rating,
       a.total_duration
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN gaps g ON g.director_id = a.director_id
ORDER BY a.num_movies DESC, a.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM nums WHERE n < 19), cohort AS (SELECT id_bioguide, CAST(strftime('%Y', MIN(term_start)) AS INTEGER) AS first_year FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide HAVING MIN(term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'), pairs AS (SELECT c.id_bioguide, nums.n AS n, (c.first_year + nums.n) || '-12-31' AS chk_date FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN nums), retained AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.n AS n, p.id_bioguide FROM pairs p JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide = p.id_bioguide WHERE t.term_start <= p.chk_date AND t.term_end >= p.chk_date), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cohort_size FROM cohort), per_year AS (SELECT n, COUNT(*) AS retained_count FROM retained GROUP BY n) SELECT nums.n + 1 AS retention_year, totals.cohort_size AS cohort_size, COALESCE(per_year.retained_count, 0) AS retained_legislators, CAST(COALESCE(per_year.retained_count, 0) AS REAL) / totals.cohort_size AS retention_rate FROM nums CROSS JOIN totals LEFT JOIN per_year ON per_year.n = nums.n ORDER BY nums.n

WITH film_rev AS (SELECT i.film_id AS film_id, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY i.film_id), actor_cnt AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_id) AS n_actors FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id), ranked AS (SELECT fa.actor_id AS actor_id, f.title AS title, CAST(fr.revenue AS REAL) / ac.n_actors AS share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fa.actor_id ORDER BY fr.revenue DESC, f.title ASC) AS rk FROM film_actor fa JOIN film_rev fr ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor_cnt ac ON ac.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id) SELECT a.actor_id AS actor_id, a.first_name AS first_name, a.last_name AS last_name, GROUP_CONCAT(t.title, ', ') AS top_three_films, ROUND(AVG(t.share), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_actor FROM actor a JOIN (SELECT actor_id, title, share, rk FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY actor_id, rk) t ON t.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY a.actor_id

WITH RECURSIVE pool AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words AS word
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
),
chars(word, ch, rest) AS (
  SELECT word, substr(word, 1, 1), substr(word, 2) FROM pool
  UNION ALL
  SELECT word, substr(rest, 1, 1), substr(rest, 2) FROM chars WHERE LENGTH(rest) > 0
),
keys AS (
  SELECT word, group_concat(ch, '') AS k
  FROM (SELECT word, ch FROM chars ORDER BY word, ch)
  GROUP BY word
),
grp AS (
  SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM keys GROUP BY k
)
SELECT a.word AS word, g.cnt - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM keys a
JOIN grp g ON g.k = a.k
WHERE substr(a.word, 1, 1) = 'r'
  AND g.cnt > 1
ORDER BY a.word
LIMIT 10

WITH per_hub AS (
  SELECT s.hub_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS feb_orders,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mar_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
    AND o.order_created_year = 2021
    AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY s.hub_id
)
SELECT h.hub_id,
       h.hub_name,
       p.feb_orders,
       p.mar_orders,
       ROUND((CAST(p.mar_orders AS REAL) - p.feb_orders) / p.feb_orders * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM per_hub p
JOIN hubs h ON h.hub_id = p.hub_id
WHERE p.feb_orders > 0
  AND (CAST(p.mar_orders AS REAL) - p.feb_orders) / p.feb_orders > 0.2
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

WITH team_points AS (
  SELECT m.season,
         m.league_id,
         m.country_id,
         m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
         CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
              WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END AS points
  FROM Match m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.season,
         m.league_id,
         m.country_id,
         m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
         CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
              WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END AS points
  FROM Match m
),
season_points AS (
  SELECT season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id, SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM team_points
  GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id, total_points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_id, country_id ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
  FROM season_points
)
SELECT r.season,
       t.team_long_name AS champion_team,
       l.name AS league,
       c.name AS country,
       r.total_points
FROM ranked r
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.season, c.name, l.name

SELECT a.path AS page,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.session) AS total_sessions
FROM activity_log a
JOIN (
    SELECT session,
           MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp,
           MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    GROUP BY session
) s
  ON a.session = s.session
WHERE a.stamp = s.first_stamp
   OR a.stamp = s.last_stamp
GROUP BY a.path
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC, a.path

SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drives f
JOIN drives l ON l.year = f.year AND l.driver_id = f.driver_id AND l.is_final_drive_of_season = 1
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = f.driver_id
WHERE f.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  AND f.is_first_drive_of_season = 1
  AND f.constructor_id = l.constructor_id
  AND l.last_round > f.first_round
